text:
Aisha: heads up — customer reports console showing provisional > confirmed after stream reconnect + toolcall retry. Repro bundle incoming.

Tom: any request ids/traces?

Aisha: sanitized trace:
```
req_id=cli-83a2
endpoint=/v1/stream/generate
model=redwood-4b-quant
events=[stream_start, chunk(104), chunk(120), disconnect, resume(session=s-1931), resume_chunk(80), tool_call(start, id=rc-7), tool_call(truncate), retry(tool_call, id=rc-7-retry), stream_end]
provisional_tokens=304
confirmed_tokens=188
```

Ravi: looks like the truncated toolcall from the first session is being credited, then the retry credits again. The compat fallback route emits a `truncated_toolcall` event but ledger treats it as a standalone charge.

Sasha: saw similar during last canary. Router hands off to compat variant and we lose the origin_session mapping. Without origin_session we can't dedupe retries that start new sessions.

Tom: can we gate final charging on a canonical ack? e.g. only convert provisional -> confirmed when we see `session_confirm` or `stream_eof` for origin_session_id. Right now we count tokens on `chunk` and on `toolcall` events leading to overlap.

Ravi: internal API issue — some handoffs tear the connection so no clean `stream_eof`. We currently mark provisional and expect a later settle. But settle sometimes never arrives because origin_session_id got dropped.

Sasha: proposal: add `provisional:boolean`, `origin_session_id:string`, and for toolcalls `toolcall_attempt_id:string` to ledger/telemetry events. Reconcile rule: confirm by matching (origin_session_id, token_offset_end) so new sessions without the same origin won't double-count.

Aisha: short-term UX mitigator: console per-route badge "Tentative" with hover: "Includes provisional charges pending final ack — may adjust in 1–5 min". Reduce customer panic while infra fixes roll out.

Tom: backend: provisional credits auto-expire after TTL unless confirmed. TTL tradeoff: cover benign reconnects (suggest 2m) but not too long to flood refunds.

Ravi: agree TTL + origin_session_id. For toolcalls save `toolcall_attempt_id` and `finalized` flag. Example event payload as string in logs:
{ event: "toolcall_charge", attempt_id: "rc-7", origin_session_id: "s-1931", tokens: "116", provisional: "true" }
When `finalized=true` or `session_confirm` for that origin, flip or reconcile duplicates.

Sasha: implementation note — router currently drops origin_session_id on handoff due to a types mismatch. I'll add a compatibility shim to preserve it (1–2d).

deploy-bot: deploy/canary finished for infra/router-shim (commit e3b9f2) ✅

Aisha: after shim, add integration test that simulates: connect -> chunks -> server disconnect -> resume with new session id -> retry toolcall. Expect: provisional visible briefly, then either confirm on finalize or auto-expire/refund within TTL.

Tom: add debug log when origin_session_id is dropped: `origin_session_dropped=true req_id=...`. That will help repros.

Ravi: I'll draft an RFD for ledger dedupe rule and telemetry schema change. Hold refunds policy until we have telemetry rates.

Sasha: for console UX I'll mock two screens: (1) per-route tentative indicator, (2) per-request hover showing token timeline (provisional vs confirmed) with timestamps. Posting mocks shortly.

Aisha: TL;DR: preserve origin_session_id through handoffs, emit provisional + attempt ids, provisional TTL, and UI badge. Follow-ups: RFD (Ravi), UX mock (Sasha), tests & tooltip copy (Tom).

Tom: assigning follow-ups: @Ravi RFD, @Sasha UX, @Tom tests. I'll pick this up tomorrow infra hours.

Aisha: thanks — I'll upload the customer's sanitized bundle when I have it. :thumbsup:
